product_overview: Sikkanam is a free Tamil Nadu travel budgeting and itinerary planning platform that helps travelers discover destinations, compare trip costs transparently, and generate practical itineraries. It combines destination exploration, AI-assisted planning, and structured trip optimization with live travel intelligence.
core_goals: Discover Tamil Nadu destinations by category or search
Generate budget-aware trip plans for a chosen destination and travel style
Get AI-assisted itinerary suggestions with itemized travel cost breakdowns
Browse detailed destination information including attractions, transit tips, and accommodations
Save and revisit travel ideas and generated itineraries

features.name: Explore Destinations
features.description: Lets users search and filter Tamil Nadu destinations and open a destination’s detailed view.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Search for a destination by name -> Review matching destination cards -> Open a destination card -> See destination details with attractions, transit tips, and accommodations
Navigate to /explore -> Apply a category filter such as Hill or Beach -> Review the filtered destination list -> Open a destination card -> See the full destination overview

features.name: Destination Details
features.description: Shows a detailed destination page with practical travel information for a selected place.
user_flows: Navigate to a destination detail page from the destination explorer -> Review attractions, transit tips, and accommodation information -> Use the destination information to evaluate the trip
Navigate to /explore -> Search for a destination -> Open a destination card -> See the detailed destination page for that place

features.name: AI Trip Planning Chat
features.description: Provides a conversational AI travel companion that generates budget-friendly trip advice and itineraries.
user_flows: Navigate to /ai -> Type a trip query such as a short budget trip request -> Submit the request -> See a day-wise itinerary with an itemized cost breakdown
Navigate to /ai -> Select a quick prompt -> Review the generated travel plan -> Compare the suggested budget and itinerary details

features.name: Interactive Trip Planner
features.description: Helps users create a structured travel plan by choosing destination, duration, traveler count, and budget tier.
user_flows: Navigate to /plan -> Select a destination -> Adjust trip duration and traveler count -> Choose a budget tier -> Generate the plan -> See cost breakdown and hotel recommendations
Navigate to /plan -> Enter a trip setup -> Generate the itinerary -> Review the recommended plan and estimated expenses

features.name: Booking Assistance
features.description: Provides official booking guidance for supported transport and accommodation options.
user_flows: Navigate to /booking -> Review the available booking assistance options -> Choose a travel mode or hotel assistance path -> Follow the guided booking information
Navigate to /booking -> Compare official assistance for buses, trains, and hotels -> Use the provided booking guidance to continue planning

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Allows users to save destinations they want to revisit later.
user_flows: Navigate to the wishlist page -> Review saved destinations -> Return to previously saved travel ideas
Navigate to a destination or travel plan flow -> Save a place to the wishlist -> Open /wishlist -> See the saved destination in the list

features.name: Saved Trips
features.description: Keeps a history of generated and saved travel itineraries for later reference.
user_flows: Navigate to /saved-trips -> Review previously generated itineraries -> Open a saved trip for reference
Generate a travel plan -> Save the itinerary -> Navigate to /saved-trips -> See the saved plan in the trip history

features.name: Maps
features.description: Displays an interactive Tamil Nadu map for transit and tourist spot discovery.
user_flows: Navigate to /maps -> Browse the interactive map -> Inspect transit links and tourist spot locations -> Use the map to support trip planning
